name: DIAGNOSTIC fast
notes: NOT A SOLDERING PROFILE. Peaks at 95 C, holds it for 20 s, and the whole cycle is 84 s. It exercises preheat, soak, a liquidus crossing, peak, cooldown, report, every screen, the chart and the console commands. liquidus_c is 80 C purely so the run crosses it; that number means nothing metallurgical. Melts no solder and reflows nothing. It does apply real heat: 95 C is hot enough to matter to anything left inside, and hot enough that the oven is well over the 45 C pre-flight limit when the run ends, so back-to-back iterations wait for a real cooldown. An earlier version peaked near 39 C and did allow that, but was too cool to exercise the control loop meaningfully. Note that on a curve this short the oven overshoots by several degrees -- the feed-forward commands heat the thermal mass carries past -- which does not happen on a real profile's longer ramps.
